ExecuTorch just achieved 45 tok/sec INT4 local inference on mid-tier mobile NPUs.

It runs fully offline LLM reasoning on hardware previously limited to basic feature classification.

No cloud API calls. No thermal throttling. Just raw on-device NPU compilation.

Here's how it works:

- Traditional mobile runtimes load full FP16 weights into unified memory, crushing RAM limits.
- ExecuTorch bypasses CPU fallback by targeting the Hexagon NPU directly via static memory planning.
- Dynamic KV cache allocation is replaced with fixed-size pre-allocated INT4 buffers.

The result:

- 45 tokens/sec generation on Snapdragon 8 Gen 3
- Under 850 MB peak memory footprint for a 1.5B model
- Zero CPU thermal throttling during 5-minute continuous generation
- 60% reduction in battery drain compared to GPU execution

The wildest part:

You do not lose output coherence. Grouped-query attention combined with per-channel INT4 quantization keeps perplexity loss under 1.5% compared to FP16.

What this actually means:

- Instant real-time text generation without internet connectivity
- Zero API latency and total privacy for sensitive user data
- Zero cloud compute costs per user request

Compatible with iOS CoreML and Android NNAPI via PyTorch export pipelines.

Open-source under BSD License. (Link in the first comment)
